note: Vendored copy, not a live fetch. This file is metadata for the maintainer only — it is not read when the skill runs.

vendored_files.note: POSIX-only. Upstream also ships hooks/always-on.mjs (Node, primary) and hooks/always-on.ps1 (Windows PowerShell fallback) — skipped, sh covers macOS/Linux/Git Bash, which is what this repo targets. Add the other variants if a Windows-without-Git-Bash user needs them.
Rewritten to call the .sh script directly (per Claude Code plugin docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference) instead of upstream's Node-loader wrapper around always-on.mjs.

update_steps: copy over the changed content, keep the trimmed SKILL.md frontmatter (no metadata block) and the deviations below
deviations_from_upstream: hooks.json: command runs hooks/i-have-adhd-always-on.sh directly, no Node loader — see vendored_files note above.

i-have-adhd-always-on.sh: flipped from opt-in to opt-out, at the user's explicit request. Upstream gates the ruleset behind a flag file the user must create (~/.claude/.i-have-adhd-always). This fork runs it by default on every session, and only skips it when I_HAVE_ADHD_ALWAYS_ON=off is set (e.g. in settings.json's "env" block, matching the ECC_GATEGUARD=off convention from github.com/affaan-m/ECC). The flag-file check was removed entirely.

SKILL.md kept 'disable-model-invocation: true' as upstream ships it, by explicit choice. Known consequence in this Claude Code build: skills are not exposed as real CLI slash commands, and this flag also blocks the Skill tool from invoking the skill when a user types /i-have-adhd as a chat message — so on-demand invocation currently has no working path here. The SessionStart hook (now default-on) is the only way this skill actually turns on.
